annotations.title: Token analysis pack: price, supply, proxy and risk checks

description: One call to analyse an ERC-20 token: name, symbol, decimals and supply, USD price from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool, whether it is an upgradeable proxy and who can upgrade it, and on Base the honeypot and contract risk checks (paused transfers, blacklist, owner fees, mint rights, liquidity). Give a ticker or 0x address and the network (base, eth, arb, op or polygon). Use before buying, listing or accepting an unknown token. Example: token=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb, op or polygon

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC or a 0x ERC-20 contract address
